text: Thank you for coming in regarding your persistent bleeding after wisdom tooth extraction and your history of easy bruising. To better understand your condition, have you noticed excessive bleeding from minor cuts, frequent nosebleeds, or bleeding gums while brushing your teeth?

text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth.
